plugins.name: linggen
plugins.description: Linggen for Claude Code — durable cross-host memory, browser control in your own Chrome, and logged-in X reads. Two local MCP servers: ling-mem for memory, the Linggen engine for the browser, X and agents. Installs its required binaries (ling-mem + the Linggen engine, background download) on first session start. Replaces shared-memory.
